headline: New units drag margins; management reaffirms FY27 guidance

highlights: Refer to Important Disclosures at the end of this report BUY Park Medi World New units drag margins; management reaffirms FY27 guidance Healthcare  Result Update  November 14, 2026 CMP (Rs): 255 | TP (Rs): 350 Park Medi World's (Park) 2QFY27 print was muted, with losses at recently commissioned new units (Panchkula, Rudrapur, and Agra) dragging overall portfolio margins (~380bps yoy in 1H).

While the revenue trajectory remained strong (+25% yoy in 2Q) owing to bed adds, gross margins contracted ~550bps on the back of higher F&B costs (impact of ~200bps) and a change in case mix (skewed toward surgical procedures).
The management upheld its FY27 guidance (revenue/EBITDA of Rs20.5/5.45bn) on the back of new units ramping up and the 2H bed expansion pipeline remaining on track (~17% of 1HFY27 capacity).
We, however, expect a gradual improvement in margins given the steep capacity additions planned and cut our FY27/28E EBITDA by 9/8%.
valuation: We maintain BUY and cut our Sep- 27E TP by ~7% to Rs350 from Rs375, based on 20x Sep-28E EV/EBITDA.

With an improving payor mix (target of 70/30 scheme and cash), focus on high-acuity procedures and an affordable healthcare service proposition, we believe Park’s return profile will remain healthy despite aggressive expansion plans.
Target Price – 12M Sep-27 Change in TP (%) (6.7) Current Reco.
watch: Key risks: delays in collections from government-scheme patients and execution risks in new markets.
